title: Risk Game Flows
subtitle: The Risk board game on Act: one Game state per stream, every move an action, every outcome an event, with a bot engine and a turn timer playing for absent players.

slices.label: GameSlice
slices.description: The whole game: every action and event of the Game state. The app is built with act().withSlice(GameSlice).

nodes.label: Game creator
nodes.description: The player who created the game. Only the creator can start or delete it (the mustBeCreator precondition). The creator joins and plays like anyone else.

nodes.label: Player
nodes.description: A person at the table, through the tRPC API. Every move after the lobby checks that it is this player's turn (mustBeCurrentPlayer).

nodes.label: Bot engine
nodes.description: app/src/api/sync/bot-engine.ts plays a bot's turn after every state change: reinforce, attack (blitz when the odds are good), conquest moves, fortify. It acts as the bot player, so the same turn preconditions apply.

nodes.label: Turn timer
nodes.description: app/src/api/sync/turn-timer.ts schedules a deadline after every change (turnTimeoutSec, 90 s by default). On timeout it plays the rest of the absent player's turn; after repeated timeouts it replaces the player with a bot, as the system actor.

nodes.label: CreateGame
nodes.schema:
name: string ≥ 1 chars, ≤ 30 chars
turnTimeoutSec?: number ≥ 10, ≤ 600
nodes.description: Opens a lobby. The actor becomes the creator.

nodes.label: JoinGame
preconditions: Game must be in lobby phase
Game must not be full (max 6 players)
Player already joined
nodes.schema:
playerName: string ≥ 1 chars, ≤ 20 chars
color: string
bot: boolean
avatar?: string
nodes.description: Takes a seat. Also refuses a player who already joined.

nodes.label: StartGame
preconditions: Game must be in lobby phase
Game must have at least 2 players
Only the game creator can start the game
nodes.description: Shuffles the turn order, deals the 42 territories one army each, and computes each player's setup armies (40 for two players, down to 20 for six).

nodes.label: PlaceArmy
preconditions: Game must be in setup phase
Must be the current player's turn
No setup armies remaining
Invalid territory
You don't own this territory
nodes.schema: territory: string
nodes.description: Places one setup army on an owned territory. The last army on the table also emits SetupCompleted.

nodes.label: AutoDeploy
preconditions: Game must be in setup phase
Must be the current player's turn
No setup armies remaining
nodes.description: Places all of a player's remaining setup armies at once, weakest border territories first. Emits SetupCompleted too when nobody else has armies left.

nodes.label: TradeCards
preconditions: Must be the current player's turn
Can only trade cards during reinforce or attack phase
Can only trade during attack phase when holding 5+ cards
Invalid card index
Invalid card set
nodes.schema: cardIndices: number[] 3 items
nodes.description: Trades a valid set of three cards for bonus armies (4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, then +5 each). Only in reinforce, or in attack with 5+ cards.

nodes.label: Reinforce
preconditions: Game must be in reinforce phase
Must be the current player's turn
Must trade cards first (5+ cards in hand)
Invalid territory
You don't own this territory
Not enough reinforcements
nodes.schema:
territory: string
armies: number ≥ 1
nodes.description: Deploys reinforcements. A hand of 5+ cards with a valid set must be traded first. When none remain, the phase moves to attack.

nodes.label: Attack
preconditions: Game must be in attack phase
Must be the current player's turn
Must complete conquest movement first
Must trade cards first (5+ cards in hand)
Invalid territory
You don't own the attacking territory
Cannot attack your own territory
Territories are not adjacent
Not enough armies to attack (must leave at least 1)
nodes.schema:
from: string
to: string
attackDice: number ≥ 1, ≤ 3
nodes.description: Rolls one round of dice inside the action, so the event records the outcome. Taking a player's last territory also emits PlayerEliminated, and GameWon when one player remains.

nodes.label: BlitzAttack
preconditions: Game must be in attack phase
Must be the current player's turn
Must complete conquest movement first
Must trade cards first (5+ cards in hand)
Invalid territory
You don't own the attacking territory
Cannot attack your own territory
Territories are not adjacent
Not enough armies to attack (must leave at least 1)
nodes.schema:
from: string
to: string
minArmies?: number ≥ 1
nodes.description: Rolls rounds until the territory falls or the attacker is down to minArmies, and records every round in one event. Same elimination and win rules as Attack.

nodes.label: ConquestMove
preconditions: Game must be in attack phase
Must be the current player's turn
No pending conquest movement
Conquest move must match pending conquest territories
Can move 0 up to the conquest's extra armies
nodes.schema:
from: string
to: string
armies: number ≥ 0
nodes.description: Moves extra armies into a conquered territory. Attacks, ending the attack and fortifying wait until it is done.

nodes.label: EndAttack
preconditions: Game must be in attack phase
Must be the current player's turn
Must complete conquest movement first
Must trade cards first (5+ cards in hand)
nodes.description: Ends the attack phase and moves to fortify.

nodes.label: Fortify
preconditions: Game must be in fortify phase
Must be the current player's turn
Must complete conquest movement first
Invalid territory
You must own both territories
Must leave at least 1 army behind
Territories must be connected through your own territories
nodes.schema:
from: string
to: string
armies: number ≥ 1
nodes.description: Moves armies between two owned territories connected through owned territories, then ends the turn: a card if the player conquered this turn, then TurnStarted for the next player.

nodes.label: SkipFortify
preconditions: Game must be in fortify phase
Must be the current player's turn
Must complete conquest movement first
nodes.description: Ends the turn without moving armies, with the same card and next-turn events as Fortify.

nodes.label: ReplaceWithBot
nodes.schema: playerId: string
nodes.description: Hands a seat to the bot engine. The emit refuses any actor but the system.
preconditions: Only the system can replace players with bots

nodes.label: DeleteGame
preconditions: Only the game creator can start the game
Game already deleted
nodes.description: Marks the game deleted (it stays in the log). The precondition reuses the creator check, so its message says start.

nodes.label: Game
nodes.description: One Game state per stream. Every action loads it, checks the phase and turn preconditions, and its events patch it (game-patches.ts). Dice are rolled inside the action, so replaying the events always rebuilds the same board. Snapshots every 20 patches. The panel leaves out the 42 territories and the card deck.

scenarios.title: Lobby to first turn
scenarios.summary: Ana opens a game, Ben joins, the board is dealt and both place their setup armies.

steps.say: **Ana** creates a game called Weekend Campaign.
**GameCreated** opens the lobby with a 90 second turn clock. The games projection lists it.
Ana takes the first seat.
**PlayerJoined**: one player at the table.
Ana tries to start right away.
The game state refuses it: one player is not a game.
steps.reject: Game must have at least 2 players

steps.say: **Ben** joins.
Two players: now the game can start.
Ana starts the game.
**GameStarted** carries the shuffled order and the dealt board, so a replay rebuilds the same game. Each player has 19 armies left to place.
Ana places an army on Brazil.
**ArmyPlaced**, and the turn passes to Ben.
Ben lets the game place all his armies.
**AutoDeployed** spreads 19 armies over his weakest borders in one event.
Ana auto-deploys her last 18.
Her armies are placed…
…and nobody has any left, so the same action also emits **SetupCompleted**. Ana's first turn starts with 3 reinforcements.

scenarios.title: A full turn
scenarios.summary: Ana reinforces, conquers a territory, moves in, ends the attack, fortifies and earns a card.

steps.say: Ana puts all 3 reinforcements on North Africa.
**Reinforced** with none left moves the game to the attack phase.
She attacks Egypt from North Africa with 3 dice.
The dice are rolled inside the action, and **Attacked** records them: 6-5-2 against 4-1. Egypt falls, and 2 extra armies may follow.
Ana moves both extra armies in.
**ConquestMoved** clears the pending move, which unlocks attacking again or ending the phase.
She stops attacking.
**AttackPhaseEnded**: on to fortify.
Ana moves 2 armies from Brazil to North Africa, through her own territories.
**Fortified** is the first of three events from this one action.
She conquered this turn, so she draws a card: **CardEarned**.
**TurnStarted** hands the board to Ben with 3 reinforcements.

scenarios.title: Away from the keyboard
scenarios.summary: Ben stops answering. The turn timer plays for him, then hands his seat to the bot engine, and a bot's blitz knocks out another bot.

steps.say: Ben has one setup army left and his 90 seconds run out. The **turn timer** places it for him, as Ben.
**ArmyPlaced** on one of his territories…
…and it was the last army on the table, so **SetupCompleted** follows from the same action.
Turns later, Ben conquered a territory and walked away mid-attack.
The timer plays out the rest of his turn: it ends the attack…
**AttackPhaseEnded**.
…and skips fortify.
He conquered this turn, so he still earns his card.
**TurnStarted** passes the turn to General Zhukov, a bot.
That was Ben's third timeout in a row. The timer, as the **system** actor, replaces him.
**PlayerReplacedByBot**: the bot engine plays Ben's seat from now on. The games projection updates the lobby row.
Zhukov's turn: after reinforcing, the **bot engine** blitzes Ben's last territory, Ural, where the odds favor it.
**BlitzAttacked** records all four rounds in one event. Ural falls.
It was Ben's last territory: **PlayerEliminated**, and his cards go to Zhukov.
The bot ends the attack and fortifies its new border.
**Fortified**, followed by its card and the next turn (not shown).

scenarios.title: Card trade and endgame
scenarios.summary: Ana against one bot. She trades cards, reinforces, attacks and fails, and the bot's blitz takes her last territory.

steps.say: Ana trades three cards, one of each type.
**CardsTraded**: the third trade in this game is worth 8 armies.
She puts all 11 on Egypt.
On to the attack phase.
She attacks the Middle East.
Bad dice: she loses two armies and takes nothing. Losses are events too.
She stops.
**AttackPhaseEnded**.
She pulls armies back toward Egypt.
**Fortified**…
…and **TurnStarted** for Zhukov.
Zhukov has the board. The bot engine blitzes Egypt, Ana's last stronghold.
Nine rounds, and Egypt falls.
**PlayerEliminated**: Ana is out.
Only Zhukov is left: **GameWon** ends the game. The games projection records the winner.

scenarios.title: Refused moves and a win
scenarios.summary: Moves the Game state refuses, then Ana takes Ben's last territory, wins, and deletes the game.

steps.say: A latecomer tries to join the running game.
Seats are only taken in the lobby.
steps.reject: Game must be in lobby phase

steps.say: Ben attacks out of turn.
It is Ana's turn, so the state refuses it.
steps.reject: Must be the current player's turn

steps.say: Ana tries to fortify while still in the attack phase.
Wrong phase.
steps.reject: Game must be in fortify phase

steps.say: She tries a conquest move with nothing conquered.
The emit throws: there is no pending move.
Ana attacks Kamchatka, Ben's last territory.
Two defenders, two losses. Kamchatka falls.
**PlayerEliminated**: Ben is out.
One player left: **GameWon**. Three events from one attack, committed together.
Ana, the creator, deletes the finished game.
**GameDeleted** hides it from the lobby. The events stay in the log.
She clicks delete again.
The emit throws: it is already deleted.
